【任务】: 以「角色 B：迭代中」整合第 1 轮 worker 输出，按指定格式输出决策、概率估计、以及（若继续）下一轮 proposal 纯净版。

【发掘 agent 本轮输出】:
Now I have sufficient information from my research. Let me compile my assessment.

---

【状态】: 有发掘空间

【前置调研发现】
- [Comparing Human and AI Rater Effects Using the Many-Facet Rasch Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18486) (arXiv, May 2025): 将 MFRM 应用于 10 个 LLM rater 与人类专家的比较，但仅诊断 rater effects（severity/leniency），完全未涉及 contamination 建模。是 G-MFRM 最直接的"基础模型"参照。
- [Using Deterministic, Gated IRT Model to Detect Test Cheating](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11336-012-9311-3) (Psychometrika, 2013): DG-IRT 原论文，将 observed performance 分解为 genuine ability 和 cheating-inflated 两个分布。未曾被任何人迁移到 LLM contamination 领域——proposal 的跨域迁移确认为首创。
- [Preference Leakage: A Contamination Problem in LLM-as-a-judge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.01534) (ICLR 2026): 定义了 generator-judge relatedness 导致的 preference leakage，但仅提出 post-hoc contextual calibration（Error Bias 从 17.8 降至 7.3），没有 latent trait framework，没有同时建模 judge severity。
- [Judging the Judges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23178) (arXiv, April 2026): 对 9 种 debiasing 策略做经验对比，发现 style bias 占主导（0.76–0.92），但**没有提供解释性的 measurement model**——恰好是 G-MFRM 能填补的位置。
- [Bias and Uncertainty in LLM-as-a-Judge Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06939) (arXiv, May 2026): 引入 J/delta-J 诊断和 sign-reversal failure mode 分析，但停留在 classical test theory 层面，明确不涉及 latent trait modeling。
- [Quantifying Data Contamination in Psychometric Evaluations of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.07175) (arXiv, 2025): 关注心理测量量表（Big Five, PVQ-40）上的 LLM contamination，测量 item memorization / evaluation memorization / target score matching。方向不同：它测量的是 LLM 在心理学量表上的 contamination，而非 LLM-as-a-judge 评估框架中的 benchmark contamination。无交叉威胁。
- [CyclicJudge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01865) (arXiv, March 2026): 通过 round-robin 分配消除 judge bias，证明为固定 budget 下的最优策略，但**完全忽略 contamination facet**。
- [PSN-IRT / Lost in Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.15055) (AAAI 2026 Oral): 4PL neural IRT 用于 benchmark 质量诊断，不涉及 judge modeling 或 contamination correction。
- [UDA: Unsupervised Debiasing Alignment](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/40788) (AAAI 2026): 神经 K-factor 调整减少 inter-judge SD 63.4%，但是 Elo-based 而非 psychometric latent trait framework，且不处理 contamination。
- 调研总结：该领域当前研究者明确分成两条路径——judge bias correction（多用 round-robin / post-hoc calibration / neural alignment）和 contamination detection（多用 black-box statistical comparison / log-prob analysis）。两条路径的工具箱、formalism、乃至研究社区都不同。至今**无人**在单一 psychometric framework 中同时建模这两个 facet，proposal 的 gap claim 经调研确认成立。

---

【发掘点 1】
- 维度: 核心 claim 强化
- 内容: Proposal 当前的核心叙事是"bridging two research silos"，这虽然准确，但本质上只是一个"integration"故事（"两个好东西放一起更好"）。更有力的 claim 应该是：**judge severity 和 contamination susceptibility 在现有方法中是 confounded 的，sequential correction 会引入 estimation bias，因此 joint calibration 不是 nice-to-have 而是 methodologically necessary。** 具体论证链条：(1) 如果一个 model 在 contaminated items 上得分异常高，现有 bias-only 方法（如 CyclicJudge）会将部分 contamination inflation 归因为 genuine ability 差异，导致 θ_n 偏高；(2) 反过来，如果某 judge 特别严格，contamination-only 方法（如 DCR）会低估受该 judge 评判的 model 的 contamination 程度，因为 performance inflation 被 severity 吸收了。(3) 只有在同一个似然函数中同时估计 d_j 和 c_n，才能避免这种互相污染。这个论证将 G-MFRM 从"我们能这么做"升级为"你必须这么做"，直接堵住审稿人"为什么不直接 pipeline 两步法"的质疑。
- 价值: 命中 Significance 和 Novelty 双重维度。将 contribution 从 engineering contribution（整合现有方法）提升为 methodological insight（揭示 confounding 问题的存在及其后果）。这也为 naive two-stage pipeline baseline 的存在提供了理论预测——不是"跑了实验发现 joint 比 sequential 好"，而是"理论上就应该好，实验验证"。
- 调研依据: Fiedler (arXiv:2605.06939) 已经指出 shared calibration across models 会引入 sign-reversal failure mode——这正是不 jointly model 导致的后果的一个特例。Proposal 可以将 Fiedler 的发现定位为"在 CTT 框架中观察到的 confounding 症状"，而 G-MFRM 是"在 latent trait 框架中的根治方案"。

【发掘点 2】
- 维度: novelty 锐化
- 内容: DG-IRT 的跨域迁移是这篇论文最独特的 intellectual contribution，但当前 proposal 对这个迁移的 non-triviality 论述不足。Proposal 应更显式地阐明：DG-IRT 原始设定（educational testing）和 LLM benchmark contamination 之间存在**关键 structural analogy**，但也有**关键 structural difference**，而 G-MFRM 的设计决策正是应对这些 difference 的产物。
  - **Analogy**：DG-IRT 中 examinee 对应 LLM model，item exposure status 对应 benchmark leakage indicator，cheating ability 对应 contamination susceptibility — 这些是 straightforward mapping。
  - **Difference 1**：DG-IRT 中 exposure status 是 binary（已泄露/未泄露），而 LLM benchmark contamination 是 continuous（不同程度的数据泄露）→ 这 motivates 使用 continuous e_i 而非 binary indicator。
  - **Difference 2**：DG-IRT 没有 "rater/judge" facet（考试是机器评分的）→ 这正是引入 MFRM d_j facet 的 structural reason，也是为什么不能直接拿 DG-IRT 用。
  - **Difference 3**：DG-IRT 的 exposure status 通常由 test administrator 掌握 → LLM 场景中必须从外部信号估计，这 motivates 整个 Stage 2 external anchoring 设计。
  这种"analogy + difference + how we address difference"的论述结构会让审稿人看到这不是简单的"把别人的模型搬过来"，而是经过了 domain-specific adaptation 的新模型。
- 价值: 直接命中 Novelty 维度。当前 proposal 虽然提到了 DG-IRT inspiration，但如果审稿人觉得"这就是把 DG-IRT 和 MFRM 拼在一起"，novelty 分会很低。显式论证 structural differences 和 design decisions 的对应关系，能有效防御"trivial combination"的攻击。
- 调研依据: DG-IRT 原论文 (Shu et al., Psychometrika 2013) 使用 binary exposure indicator 和 MCMC estimation，且在 single-rater (machine-scored) 设定下工作。将其与 multi-rater（LLM judge）设定的 structural mismatch 显式化，是基于对原模型的仔细分析得出的建议。

【发掘点 3】
- 维度: significance 提升
- 内容: Proposal 当前的 validation metric 是 Kendall-τ with Chatbot Arena human votes。这是一个合理但**单维度**的 significance 论证（"排名更准"）。可以从两个方向强化 significance 的叙事：
  (1) **Interpretability as a first-class contribution**：与 CyclicJudge（只消除 bias）或 DCR（只给出 contamination-adjusted score）不同，G-MFRM 同时输出**可解释的多维参数**——每个 model 的 contamination susceptibility c_n、每个 judge 的 severity d_j、每个 item 的 difficulty b_i 和 exposure level e_i。这些参数本身就是有价值的分析工具：model developers 可以用 c_n 来审计自己的 training pipeline 是否有 data leakage；benchmark maintainers 可以用 e_i 来识别并退役高泄露 items；evaluation practitioners 可以用 d_j 来选择最 calibrated 的 judge model。这种"一次 fit，多维 insight"的价值远超"排名更准"。
  (2) **Methodological template for future psychometric LLM evaluation**：G-MFRM 展示了如何将经典 psychometric 模型（MFRM, DG-IRT, LLTM）系统性地迁移到 LLM evaluation 中。如果写好，这篇论文不只是解决一个问题，而是为这类迁移建立了方法论范式——后续工作可以在同一框架中加入更多 facet（如 prompt template effect, language effect）。
- 价值: 命中 Significance 维度。将 contribution 从"一个更好的 ranking method"扩展为"一个可解释的多维诊断框架 + 一个 psychometric-to-LLM 迁移的方法论模板"。这两个 angle 分别面向 practitioner audience 和 methodological audience，扩大了论文的受众面。
- 调研依据: Soumik (arXiv:2604.23178) 的论文做了 9 种策略的经验对比但明确指出 lacks explanatory measurement model，Fiedler (arXiv:2605.06939) 提供了 CTT-level diagnostics 但承认 doesn't do latent trait modeling。两篇论文都指向同一个需求：一个 explanatory psychometric model。G-MFRM 恰好填补这个位置，应显式定位为对这两篇论文识别出的需求的回应。

【发掘点 4】
- 维度: trivial alternative 威胁
- 内容: 审稿人最可能的 trivial alternative 攻击：**"为什么不直接在 CyclicJudge 去 bias 后的分数上跑 ConStat，或者在 ConStat 去 contamination 后的分数上跑 CyclicJudge？这两步 sequential 操作比你的 full Bayesian MCMC 简单得多。"** Proposal 已将 naive two-stage pipeline 列为 baseline（很好），但需要在 idea 层面预判并回应这个攻击。最强论证：
  (a) **Bias propagation argument**（见发掘点 1 的 confounding 论证）：sequential 操作中，第一步的 estimation error 会作为 input bias 传播到第二步，且两步之间没有 uncertainty propagation，confidence interval 会 undercover。Joint Bayesian estimation 通过完整后验分布自然处理 uncertainty propagation。
  (b) **Identifiability argument**：在 sequential pipeline 中，CyclicJudge 的 bias estimate 包含了 contamination-induced performance inflation 的成分（因为它分不开 bias 和 contamination），这意味着 "去 bias 后的分数"本身就是 biased 的。只有在同一个 likelihood 中同时识别 d_j 和 c_n，才能获得 consistent estimates。
  如果 Proposal 能在 formulation 阶段就预判并论证这一点（而非等到实验结果证明 joint > sequential），paper 的理论贡献会强很多。
- 价值: 命中 Novelty 维度（防御 trivial alternative 攻击）。这是审稿人最可能问的第一个问题。如果在 approach section 中就给出清晰的理论论证，而不是只靠实验数据说话，paper 的说服力会显著提升。
- 调研依据: 这个论证结构直接参考了经典 psychometrics 中 simultaneous vs. sequential estimation 的讨论传统，以及 Fiedler (arXiv:2605.06939) 关于 shared calibration 导致 sign-reversal 的具体案例——后者正是 sequential estimation bias 的一个实例。

【发掘点 5】
- 维度: related work 差异化
- 内容: 有一篇调研到的论文需要在 related work 中显式定位：**"Quantifying Data Contamination in Psychometric Evaluations of LLMs" (arXiv:2510.07175)**。虽然它关注的是心理学量表（Big Five, PVQ-40）上的 LLM contamination，与本 proposal 的 LLM-as-a-judge benchmark evaluation 是不同场景，但题目中同时出现 "psychometric" 和 "data contamination" 容易让审稿人误以为有重叠。Proposal 应主动做差异化：(1) 该论文研究的是 LLM 作为被试在心理学量表上的 contamination，本文研究的是 LLM 作为评判者在能力 benchmark 上的 contamination；(2) 该论文只做 detection（三个指标的测量），本文做 correction（通过 latent trait model 去除 contamination effect）；(3) 该论文不涉及 judge/rater facet。此外，**"Correcting Human Labels for Rater Effects in AI Evaluation: An Item Response Theory Approach" (arXiv:2602.22585)** 也需要关注——它用 IRT 校正 human rater effects 用于 AI evaluation，是 IRT+rater effects 方向的近期工作，虽然没有涉及 contamination，但审稿人可能认为这是更直接的 prior art。
- 价值: 命中 Related Work 差异化维度。主动定位这两篇潜在"竞品"论文，防止审稿人质疑"this is already done by X"。
- 调研依据: 直接来自 WebSearch 发现的 arXiv:2510.07175 和 arXiv:2602.22585。

Sources:
- [Comparing Human and AI Rater Effects Using the Many-Facet Rasch Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18486)
- [Using Deterministic, Gated IRT Model to Detect Test Cheating](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11336-012-9311-3)
- [Preference Leakage: A Contamination Problem in LLM-as-a-judge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.01534)
- [Judging the Judges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23178)
- [Bias and Uncertainty in LLM-as-a-Judge Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06939)
- [Quantifying Data Contamination in Psychometric Evaluations of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.07175)
- [CyclicJudge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01865)
- [PSN-IRT / Lost in Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.15055)
- [UDA: Unsupervised Debiasing Alignment](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/40788)
- [ConStat](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.16281)
- [Correcting Human Labels for Rater Effects in AI Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.22585)

【补救 agent 本轮输出】:
Now I have sufficient research to make a thorough assessment. Let me compile my findings.

---

【状态】: 有缺陷待补救

【前置调研发现】
- **CyclicJudge (arXiv:2603.01865, March 2026)**: 在 MT-Bench 和 MindEval 上做方差分解实验（scenario/generation/judge/residual），baseline 是 single-judge、random-assignment、fixed-judge 等分配策略。评估指标为方差占比和 ranking stability。没有用 contamination 相关的对照。
- **"Judging the Judges" (arXiv:2604.23178, April 2026)**: 比较 9 种 debiasing 策略×5 个 judge 模型×3 个 benchmark (MT-Bench n=400, LLMBar n=200, custom n=225)×4 种 bias type。发现 style bias (0.76–0.92) 远超 position bias (≤0.04)。实验标准：多 benchmark、多 judge 交叉验证。
- **UDA (AAAI 2026)**: 在 pairwise evaluation 中用 neural K-factor 调整 Elo rating，以减少 inter-judge 标准差 63.4%。Baseline 包括 raw Elo、fixed-K Elo、multi-judge average。评估用 Elo convergence dispersion 和 ranking stability。
- **Bias-Bounded Evaluation (arXiv:2603.05485, March 2026)**: 在 Arena-Hard-Auto 上用 4 个 LLM judges 验证，retaining 61–99% ranking correlation (τ)。提供 formal (τ, δ)-bias-bounded guarantees。这是 judge bias 领域唯一提供形式化保证的方法。
- **ConStat (NeurIPS 2024)**: 通过 GPT-4-Turbo 生成 rephrased/synthetic reference samples (~1000/benchmark)，在 MMLU、HellaSwag、ARC 等**多选/factual benchmarks** 上验证。r²=0.94 是在有 ground-truth contamination 的 fine-tuned 模型上验证的。
- **DCR (EMNLP 2025)**: 在 9 个 LLMs (0.5B–72B) 上验证，覆盖 sentiment analysis、fake news detection、arithmetic reasoning。评估 DCR Factor 调整后准确率与 uncontaminated baseline 差距 (~4%)。
- **Preference Leakage (ICLR 2026)**: 定义 3 种 generator-judge 关联（same model, inheritance, same family），用 preference leakage score 量化 bias。实验覆盖多个 LLM baseline 和 benchmark。
- **PSN-IRT (AAAI 2026)**: 在 11 个 benchmarks、41,871 items、12 个 LLMs 上评估。用 neural 4PL IRT 估计 item 参数和 model ability，评估指标包括 measurement quality（reliability, item fit）。
- **Fiedler (arXiv:2605.06939, May 2026)**: 提出 J/ΔJ 诊断指标，在 MMLU-Pro 上展示 sign-reversal failure mode。强调 shared-calibration comparison 的危险性。
- **"How to Correctly Report LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluations" (arXiv:2511.21140)**: 引入 Rogan-Gladen (1978) estimator 用于 bias correction under distribution shift。这是一个理论上 unbiased 的 estimator，可能是审稿人会要求对比的 baseline。
- **MT-Bench 2026 现状**: 多个来源确认 frontier models 在 MT-Bench 上已接近饱和（scores clustering near ceiling），discriminative power 下降。Arena-Hard 和 WildBench 目前仍有区分度。
- **调研总结**: 该领域当前实验标准要求：(1) 多 benchmark 交叉验证（至少 2–3 个）；(2) 多 judge 覆盖（4–8 个，跨 provider family）；(3) 与 Chatbot Arena 的 ranking correlation 作为 primary metric，但通常还需 Spearman-ρ、top-k accuracy 等辅助指标；(4) baseline 需覆盖当前主流的 bias correction 和 contamination detection 方法；(5) 审稿人普遍要求解释 compute overhead 与 improvement 的 trade-off。

---

【缺陷 1】
- 类别: 实验设计不足 — ConStat 从 factual benchmark 到 open-ended generation benchmark 的迁移未充分论证
- 问题: ConStat 原始论文在 MMLU、HellaSwag、ARC 等**有标准答案的 factual/classification benchmark** 上验证（r²=0.94），其 contamination 定义为"performance inflation that does not generalize to rephrased samples"。但 proposal 要将 ConStat 迁移到 MT-Bench、Arena-Hard、WildBench 这些**open-ended generation benchmark** 上，其中 performance 由 LLM judge 评分决定，没有标准答案。这个迁移带来两个未解决的问题：(a) 对 open-ended prompt 进行 rephrasing 后如何确保"等价难度"——factual question 的 rephrasing 保留了唯一正确答案，但 open-ended prompt 的 rephrasing 可能改变任务本质；(b) judge 评分本身引入额外噪声，model 在 original vs. rephrased version 上的 score 差异可能来自 judge inconsistency 而非 contamination。Proposal 中仅提到"GPT-5.5/Claude-assisted rephrasing (validated by human equivalence checking)"，但未说明 equivalence 的具体判定标准、human annotator 数量、inter-annotator agreement 指标。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案: (1) 明确定义 open-ended prompt rephrasing 的 equivalence 标准——建议参考 WildBench 的 checklist-based evaluation，为 original 和 rephrased prompt 生成 task-specific checklist，验证 checklist overlap 率 ≥ 90% 作为 equivalence 标准；(2) 要求至少 3 名 human annotator 对 rephrased prompt 进行 equivalence 判定，报告 Fleiss' κ ≥ 0.7；(3) 在 ConStat delta score 计算中，使用**同一组 judge**对 original 和 rephrased version 评分，以控制 judge noise；(4) 在论文中增加一个 validation study 小节，展示 ConStat 在 open-ended benchmark 上的 calibration quality（e.g., 用已知 contaminated 模型验证 delta score 是否能正确反映 contamination）；(5) 如果资源允许，可以在一个有 ground truth 的小规模 controlled experiment 中验证（e.g., 对 open-weight model 在特定 MT-Bench 子集上做 fine-tuning，人为注入 contamination，验证 ConStat delta score 与注入量的相关性）。
- 调研依据: ConStat 原论文 (NeurIPS 2024) 的实验仅在 factual benchmarks 上验证；open-ended generation benchmark 的 rephrasing 等价性问题在调研中未发现成熟解决方案，属于本 proposal 需要自行解决的 methodological gap。

【缺陷 2】
- 类别: baseline 不足或过时
- 问题: Proposal 列出的 5 个 baseline（raw multi-judge averages, CyclicJudge, DCR, Preference Leakage, naive two-stage pipeline）覆盖了 bias-only 和 contamination-only 两类，但遗漏了两个审稿人很可能要求对比的方法：(a) **UDA (AAAI 2026)** — 同样解决 judge bias，通过 neural K-factor 动态调整 Elo rating，inter-judge 标准差降低 63.4%。UDA 在 Landscape 中已被提及但未列为 baseline。(b) **Bias-Bounded Evaluation (arXiv:2603.05485)** — 该领域唯一提供 formal (τ, δ)-bias-bounded guarantees 的方法，在 Arena-Hard-Auto 上 retaining 61–99% ranking correlation。这两个都是 2026 年的 judge bias correction 新方法，审稿人会期望看到与它们的对比。此外，"How to Correctly Report LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluations" (arXiv:2511.21140) 中的 Rogan-Gladen estimator 是一个理论上 unbiased under distribution shift 的简单 baseline，也应考虑纳入。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案: (1) 将 UDA 加入 baseline list 作为第 6 个 baseline — UDA 基于 Elo rating 的 pairwise evaluation，与 G-MFRM 的 scoring-based evaluation 不完全可比，但可以在同一组 pairwise data 上运行 UDA 然后转换为 ranking，再比较 Kendall-τ；(2) 将 Bias-Bounded Evaluation 加入作为第 7 个 baseline — 它提供了形式化保证，审稿人会想看 G-MFRM 的 empirical improvement 是否超过 Bias-Bounded 的 guaranteed performance；(3) Rogan-Gladen estimator 可以作为 supplementary baseline，因为它是一个极其简单的 bias correction 方法，能帮助展示 G-MFRM 的 added value。增加这些 baseline 的 compute cost 较低（UDA 和 Bias-Bounded 都有公开代码），主要是集成工作。
- 调研依据: UDA (AAAI 2026) 在 judge bias correction 领域报告了 SOTA 的 inter-judge agreement improvement；Bias-Bounded Evaluation 是唯一提供 formal guarantee 的方法；两者都是 2026 年发表/预印的，审稿人对这些 concurrent work 会有较高期望。

【缺陷 3】
- 类别: 评估方案缺陷
- 问题: Proposal 的 primary evaluation metric 是 Kendall-τ rank correlation with held-out Chatbot Arena human votes。虽然这是该领域的标准做法（Arena-Hard、WildBench 都以此验证），但仅用单一 correlation metric 有以下风险：(a) Kendall-τ 对 top-ranked models 的 ranking 变化不够敏感——如果 G-MFRM 主要改善了 mid-tier 模型的排名但 top-3 保持不变，Kendall-τ 可能差异很小；(b) Chatbot Arena 的 prompt distribution 与 MT-Bench/Arena-Hard/WildBench 有显著差异（Arena 是 crowdsourced open-ended conversations），ranking correlation 可能因为 prompt distribution mismatch 而被 attenuate；(c) 没有 per-model 的 evaluation — 无法展示 G-MFRM 具体修正了哪些模型的错误排名。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案: (1) 增加 **Spearman-ρ** 和 **weighted Kendall-τ (τ_w)** 作为辅助 correlation metrics — τ_w 对 top-rank discordance 给予更高权重，更适合评估 evaluation framework 的实用价值；(2) 增加 **top-k ranking accuracy**（k=3, 5）——检验 G-MFRM 是否正确识别了 top 模型；(3) 增加 **pairwise accuracy** — 对每对模型，检验 G-MFRM 是否与 Chatbot Arena 的 pairwise 结果一致；(4) 增加 **per-model case study** — 展示 2–3 个 G-MFRM correction 最显著的模型，可视化其在 raw average vs. G-MFRM 中的排名变化，并分析 contamination estimate c_n 与已知信息的一致性；(5) 如果可能，在 Chatbot Arena 的 category-specific leaderboard（e.g., coding, math, hard prompts）上分别计算 correlation，检验 G-MFRM 在不同 prompt type 上的表现。
- 调研依据: WildBench 论文同时报告了 Pearson correlation 和 Spearman ρ；Arena-Hard 报告了 confidence interval bootstrap；"Judging the Judges" (Soumik 2026) 使用了多种 bias metric 交叉验证。领域标准是多指标验证。

【缺陷 4】
- 类别: 实验设计不足 — MT-Bench 饱和问题
- 问题: 多个 2026 年来源确认 frontier models 在 MT-Bench 上已接近 ceiling（scores clustering at 9.0+）。Proposal 使用的 8 个 judge 中多数为 2026 frontier models（GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Sonnet 4.6, DeepSeek-V4-Pro 等），它们**既作为 judge 又可能作为被评估模型**。如果被评估模型在 MT-Bench 上的 scores 高度聚集，MFRM 的 item difficulty 和 model ability 估计将缺乏足够方差，导致 contamination effect (c_n · e_i) 难以从 noise 中分离。这不影响 Arena-Hard 和 WildBench（目前仍有区分度），但可能导致 MT-Bench 上的结果缺乏说服力。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案: (1) 在论文中明确报告 MT-Bench 上各模型的 score distribution 和 variance，如果 variance 极低则坦诚说明 limitation；(2) 将 MT-Bench 的 primary 地位降为 supplementary，以 Arena-Hard 和 WildBench 作为 primary benchmark — 它们在 2026 仍有区分度；(3) 考虑增加一个更有区分度的 benchmark，例如 **Arena-Hard v2**（如果存在更新版本）或 **LMSYS-Chat-1M 子集**；(4) 在 evaluating models 时纳入 2–3 个非 frontier 模型（如 Llama 4 8B、Qwen3-7B）增加 score range，使 MFRM 有更多 variance 来估计参数；(5) 如果 MT-Bench 饱和严重，可以在 ablation 中展示 G-MFRM 在高区分度 benchmark (Arena-Hard) vs. 低区分度 benchmark (MT-Bench) 上的 correction 效果差异，这本身也是一个有价值的 finding。
- 调研依据: 多个 2026 年 benchmark 综述确认 MT-Bench 对 frontier models 的 discriminative power 下降；PSN-IRT (AAAI 2026) 的经验是在 41,871 items 上才获得可靠的 IRT parameter estimates。

【缺陷 5】
- 类别: ablation 不完整
- 问题: Proposal 列出了 5 项 additional analyses（exposure indicator ablation, judge count sensitivity, facet fit statistics, person-fit validation, adversarial robustness），但遗漏了两个重要的 ablation：(a) **Gating mechanism ablation** — G-MFRM 的核心创新是 multiplicative gating (c_n · e_i)，但没有与 additive contamination control（即 logit(P) = θ_n − b_i − d_j + c_n + e_i，additive main effects without interaction）做对比。如果 additive model 表现相当，则 multiplicative gating 的 added complexity 不 justified。(b) **Stage-wise ablation** — 没有对比"Stage 1 + Stage 2 only (不做 Stage 3 joint refit)"vs."full 3-stage pipeline"。Stage 1+2 的 sequential approach 本质上就是 proposal 中批评的"naive two-stage pipeline"的 psychometric 版本，如果 Stage 3 joint refit 的 improvement 不显著，则 joint estimation 的核心 claim 被削弱。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案: (1) 增加 **additive baseline ablation**：logit(P) = θ_n − b_i − d_j + c_n + e_i，其中 c_n 和 e_i 作为 additive main effects（无交互），验证 multiplicative gating 是否显著优于 additive control；(2) 增加 **Stage 3 contribution ablation**：比较 Stage 1+2 sequential estimates vs. Stage 3 joint estimates 的 Kendall-τ 差异，量化 joint refit 的边际贡献；(3) 这两个 ablation 的 compute cost 很低（仅需重新 fit 变体模型），不影响 timeline。
- 调研依据: DG-IRT 原论文 (Shu et al., Psychometrika 2013) 对 gating vs. non-gating model 做了 formal comparison；AMMI 文献中 rank-1 vs. additive main effects 的对比是标准做法。领域实验规范要求隔离每个组件的贡献。

【缺陷 6】
- 类别: 实验设计不足 — Compute overhead 和实用性讨论缺失
- 问题: Proposal 详细描述了 G-MFRM 的技术优越性，但没有讨论其 compute/cost overhead 相对于 baselines 的 trade-off。CyclicJudge 是 cost-neutral（与 single-judge 相同 per-item cost）；raw multi-judge average 只需要 forward pass；Preference Leakage calibration 是 post-hoc 调整。而 G-MFRM 需要：(1) ConStat reference benchmark 构建（2 周 + human validation）；(2) 3-stage MCMC fitting；(3) multi-judge evaluation on both original and reference variants。审稿人会问："Kendall-τ 提升 X 个百分点 justify 了多少额外的 compute 和 human effort？"
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案: (1) 在实验结果中增加一个 **efficiency-improvement tradeoff table**，列出每种方法的 compute cost（API calls, GPU hours, human hours）和对应的 Kendall-τ；(2) 讨论 G-MFRM 的 amortized cost — 一旦 reference benchmark 构建完成，后续新模型的评估只需增量 MCMC fitting（新模型的 θ_n 和 c_n），不需要重建 reference benchmark；(3) 讨论 practical use scenario — G-MFRM 适合用于高 stakes 的 official leaderboard evaluation（如 Chatbot Arena），而非日常 model development，这个 positioning 有助于 justify overhead。
- 调研依据: 基于领域实验规范判断 — Arena-Hard 和 WildBench 论文都讨论了 cost vs. correlation tradeoff；CyclicJudge 明确以 cost-neutral 作为 selling point。

【缺陷 7】
- 类别: 可行性问题 — 被评估模型集合定义模糊
- 问题: Proposal 列出了 8 个 LLM judges（GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Sonnet 4.6, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, Kimi K2.6, Qwen3-235B-A22B, Qwen3.6-27B, Llama 4 Maverick），但没有明确说明**被评估模型集合**（即 MFRM 中的 n = 1, ..., N）是什么。这些 8 个模型既是 judges 又是 examinees？如果是，这会引入严重的 self-evaluation contamination（judge 评估自己的输出）。如果被评估模型集合不同，需要明确列出。此外，N = 8 或更少意味着 model ability θ_n 和 contamination susceptibility c_n 各仅有 8 个参数，对 Bayesian estimation 来说 sample size 可能偏小（虽然 item 数可以很大）。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案: (1) 明确被评估模型集合 — 建议设为 15–20 个模型，覆盖不同 scale（7B, 27B, 70B, MoE, frontier）和不同 provider family，以增加 θ_n 和 c_n 的估计精度；(2) 在 experimental design 中明确处理 judge = examinee 的情况 — 可以采用 leave-one-out: 当 model A 作为 examinee 时，排除 model A 作为 judge 的评分，或者将 self-evaluation 作为 bias 的一个 facet 进行建模；(3) 分析 judge-examinee overlap 对结果的 sensitivity — 作为 robustness check。
- 调研依据: CyclicJudge 采用 round-robin 避免 self-evaluation；"Judging the Judges" (Soumik 2026) 明确排除了 self-evaluation 场景。Preference Leakage (ICLR 2026) 专门研究了 generator-judge 关联性问题，同 family 的 bias 已被证实显著。

Sources:
- [CyclicJudge: Mitigating Judge Bias Efficiently in LLM-based Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01865)
- [Judging the Judges: Systematic Evaluation of Bias Mitigation Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23178)
- [UDA: Unsupervised Debiasing Alignment for Pair-wise LLM-as-a-Judge](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/40788)
- [Towards Provably Unbiased LLM Judges via Bias-Bounded Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.05485)
- [ConStat: Performance-Based Contamination Detection in Large Language Models](https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2024/file/a7f89793b9e6f8c6568dbbb6ff727b9b-Paper-Conference.pdf)
- [DCR: Quantifying Data Contamination in LLMs Evaluation](https://aclanthology.org/2025.emnlp-main.1173/)
- [Preference Leakage: A Contamination Problem in LLM-as-a-judge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.01534)
- [PSN-IRT: Lost in Benchmarks? Rethinking LLM Benchmarking with IRT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.15055)
- [Bias and Uncertainty in LLM-as-a-Judge Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06939)
- [How to Correctly Report LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluations](https://arxiv.org/html/2511.21140v3)
- [Comparing Human and AI Rater Effects Using MFRM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18486)
- [On The Fragility of Benchmark Contamination Detection in Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.02386)
- [Chatbot Arena: An Open Platform for Evaluating LLMs by Human Preference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.04132)
- [WildBench: Benchmarking LLMs with Challenging Tasks from Real Users](https://arxiv.org/html/2406.04770v1)
- [LLM Evaluation in 2026 - Benchmark Saturation](https://medium.com/@nairmilind3/llm-evaluation-in-2026-e631a78c67dc)

【任务】: 以「角色 B：迭代中」整合第 1 轮 worker 输出，按指定格式输出决策、概率估计、以及（若继续）下一轮 proposal 纯净版。

【发掘 agent 本轮输出】:
Now I have sufficient information from my research. Let me compile my assessment.

---

【状态】: 有发掘空间

【前置调研发现】
- [Comparing Human and AI Rater Effects Using the Many-Facet Rasch Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18486) (arXiv, May 2025): 将 MFRM 应用于 10 个 LLM rater 与人类专家的比较，但仅诊断 rater effects（severity/leniency），完全未涉及 contamination 建模。是 G-MFRM 最直接的"基础模型"参照。
- [Using Deterministic, Gated IRT Model to Detect Test Cheating](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11336-012-9311-3) (Psychometrika, 2013): DG-IRT 原论文，将 observed performance 分解为 genuine ability 和 cheating-inflated 两个分布。未曾被任何人迁移到 LLM contamination 领域——proposal 的跨域迁移确认为首创。
- [Preference Leakage: A Contamination Problem in LLM-as-a-judge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.01534) (ICLR 2026): 定义了 generator-judge relatedness 导致的 preference leakage，但仅提出 post-hoc contextual calibration（Error Bias 从 17.8 降至 7.3），没有 latent trait framework，没有同时建模 judge severity。
- [Judging the Judges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23178) (arXiv, April 2026): 对 9 种 debiasing 策略做经验对比，发现 style bias 占主导（0.76–0.92），但**没有提供解释性的 measurement model**——恰好是 G-MFRM 能填补的位置。
- [Bias and Uncertainty in LLM-as-a-Judge Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06939) (arXiv, May 2026): 引入 J/delta-J 诊断和 sign-reversal failure mode 分析，但停留在 classical test theory 层面，明确不涉及 latent trait modeling。
- [Quantifying Data Contamination in Psychometric Evaluations of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.07175) (arXiv, 2025): 关注心理测量量表（Big Five, PVQ-40）上的 LLM contamination，测量 item memorization / evaluation memorization / target score matching。方向不同：它测量的是 LLM 在心理学量表上的 contamination，而非 LLM-as-a-judge 评估框架中的 benchmark contamination。无交叉威胁。
- [CyclicJudge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01865) (arXiv, March 2026): 通过 round-robin 分配消除 judge bias，证明为固定 budget 下的最优策略，但**完全忽略 contamination facet**。
- [PSN-IRT / Lost in Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.15055) (AAAI 2026 Oral): 4PL neural IRT 用于 benchmark 质量诊断，不涉及 judge modeling 或 contamination correction。
- [UDA: Unsupervised Debiasing Alignment](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/40788) (AAAI 2026): 神经 K-factor 调整减少 inter-judge SD 63.4%，但是 Elo-based 而非 psychometric latent trait framework，且不处理 contamination。
- 调研总结：该领域当前研究者明确分成两条路径——judge bias correction（多用 round-robin / post-hoc calibration / neural alignment）和 contamination detection（多用 black-box statistical comparison / log-prob analysis）。两条路径的工具箱、formalism、乃至研究社区都不同。至今**无人**在单一 psychometric framework 中同时建模这两个 facet，proposal 的 gap claim 经调研确认成立。

---

【发掘点 1】
- 维度: 核心 claim 强化
- 内容: Proposal 当前的核心叙事是"bridging two research silos"，这虽然准确，但本质上只是一个"integration"故事（"两个好东西放一起更好"）。更有力的 claim 应该是：**judge severity 和 contamination susceptibility 在现有方法中是 confounded 的，sequential correction 会引入 estimation bias，因此 joint calibration 不是 nice-to-have 而是 methodologically necessary。** 具体论证链条：(1) 如果一个 model 在 contaminated items 上得分异常高，现有 bias-only 方法（如 CyclicJudge）会将部分 contamination inflation 归因为 genuine ability 差异，导致 θ_n 偏高；(2) 反过来，如果某 judge 特别严格，contamination-only 方法（如 DCR）会低估受该 judge 评判的 model 的 contamination 程度，因为 performance inflation 被 severity 吸收了。(3) 只有在同一个似然函数中同时估计 d_j 和 c_n，才能避免这种互相污染。这个论证将 G-MFRM 从"我们能这么做"升级为"你必须这么做"，直接堵住审稿人"为什么不直接 pipeline 两步法"的质疑。
- 价值: 命中 Significance 和 Novelty 双重维度。将 contribution 从 engineering contribution（整合现有方法）提升为 methodological insight（揭示 confounding 问题的存在及其后果）。这也为 naive two-stage pipeline baseline 的存在提供了理论预测——不是"跑了实验发现 joint 比 sequential 好"，而是"理论上就应该好，实验验证"。
- 调研依据: Fiedler (arXiv:2605.06939) 已经指出 shared calibration across models 会引入 sign-reversal failure mode——这正是不 jointly model 导致的后果的一个特例。Proposal 可以将 Fiedler 的发现定位为"在 CTT 框架中观察到的 confounding 症状"，而 G-MFRM 是"在 latent trait 框架中的根治方案"。

【发掘点 2】
- 维度: novelty 锐化
- 内容: DG-IRT 的跨域迁移是这篇论文最独特的 intellectual contribution，但当前 proposal 对这个迁移的 non-triviality 论述不足。Proposal 应更显式地阐明：DG-IRT 原始设定（educational testing）和 LLM benchmark contamination 之间存在**关键 structural analogy**，但也有**关键 structural difference**，而 G-MFRM 的设计决策正是应对这些 difference 的产物。
  - **Analogy**：DG-IRT 中 examinee 对应 LLM model，item exposure status 对应 benchmark leakage indicator，cheating ability 对应 contamination susceptibility — 这些是 straightforward mapping。
  - **Difference 1**：DG-IRT 中 exposure status 是 binary（已泄露/未泄露），而 LLM benchmark contamination 是 continuous（不同程度的数据泄露）→ 这 motivates 使用 continuous e_i 而非 binary indicator。
  - **Difference 2**：DG-IRT 没有 "rater/judge" facet（考试是机器评分的）→ 这正是引入 MFRM d_j facet 的 structural reason，也是为什么不能直接拿 DG-IRT 用。
  - **Difference 3**：DG-IRT 的 exposure status 通常由 test administrator 掌握 → LLM 场景中必须从外部信号估计，这 motivates 整个 Stage 2 external anchoring 设计。
  这种"analogy + difference + how we address difference"的论述结构会让审稿人看到这不是简单的"把别人的模型搬过来"，而是经过了 domain-specific adaptation 的新模型。
- 价值: 直接命中 Novelty 维度。当前 proposal 虽然提到了 DG-IRT inspiration，但如果审稿人觉得"这就是把 DG-IRT 和 MFRM 拼在一起"，novelty 分会很低。显式论证 structural differences 和 design decisions 的对应关系，能有效防御"trivial combination"的攻击。
- 调研依据: DG-IRT 原论文 (Shu et al., Psychometrika 2013) 使用 binary exposure indicator 和 MCMC estimation，且在 single-rater (machine-scored) 设定下工作。将其与 multi-rater（LLM judge）设定的 structural mismatch 显式化，是基于对原模型的仔细分析得出的建议。

【发掘点 3】
- 维度: significance 提升
- 内容: Proposal 当前的 validation metric 是 Kendall-τ with Chatbot Arena human votes。这是一个合理但**单维度**的 significance 论证（"排名更准"）。可以从两个方向强化 significance 的叙事：
  (1) **Interpretability as a first-class contribution**：与 CyclicJudge（只消除 bias）或 DCR（只给出 contamination-adjusted score）不同，G-MFRM 同时输出**可解释的多维参数**——每个 model 的 contamination susceptibility c_n、每个 judge 的 severity d_j、每个 item 的 difficulty b_i 和 exposure level e_i。这些参数本身就是有价值的分析工具：model developers 可以用 c_n 来审计自己的 training pipeline 是否有 data leakage；benchmark maintainers 可以用 e_i 来识别并退役高泄露 items；evaluation practitioners 可以用 d_j 来选择最 calibrated 的 judge model。这种"一次 fit，多维 insight"的价值远超"排名更准"。
  (2) **Methodological template for future psychometric LLM evaluation**：G-MFRM 展示了如何将经典 psychometric 模型（MFRM, DG-IRT, LLTM）系统性地迁移到 LLM evaluation 中。如果写好，这篇论文不只是解决一个问题，而是为这类迁移建立了方法论范式——后续工作可以在同一框架中加入更多 facet（如 prompt template effect, language effect）。
- 价值: 命中 Significance 维度。将 contribution 从"一个更好的 ranking method"扩展为"一个可解释的多维诊断框架 + 一个 psychometric-to-LLM 迁移的方法论模板"。这两个 angle 分别面向 practitioner audience 和 methodological audience，扩大了论文的受众面。
- 调研依据: Soumik (arXiv:2604.23178) 的论文做了 9 种策略的经验对比但明确指出 lacks explanatory measurement model，Fiedler (arXiv:2605.06939) 提供了 CTT-level diagnostics 但承认 doesn't do latent trait modeling。两篇论文都指向同一个需求：一个 explanatory psychometric model。G-MFRM 恰好填补这个位置，应显式定位为对这两篇论文识别出的需求的回应。

【发掘点 4】
- 维度: trivial alternative 威胁
- 内容: 审稿人最可能的 trivial alternative 攻击：**"为什么不直接在 CyclicJudge 去 bias 后的分数上跑 ConStat，或者在 ConStat 去 contamination 后的分数上跑 CyclicJudge？这两步 sequential 操作比你的 full Bayesian MCMC 简单得多。"** Proposal 已将 naive two-stage pipeline 列为 baseline（很好），但需要在 idea 层面预判并回应这个攻击。最强论证：
  (a) **Bias propagation argument**（见发掘点 1 的 confounding 论证）：sequential 操作中，第一步的 estimation error 会作为 input bias 传播到第二步，且两步之间没有 uncertainty propagation，confidence interval 会 undercover。Joint Bayesian estimation 通过完整后验分布自然处理 uncertainty propagation。
  (b) **Identifiability argument**：在 sequential pipeline 中，CyclicJudge 的 bias estimate 包含了 contamination-induced performance inflation 的成分（因为它分不开 bias 和 contamination），这意味着 "去 bias 后的分数"本身就是 biased 的。只有在同一个 likelihood 中同时识别 d_j 和 c_n，才能获得 consistent estimates。
  如果 Proposal 能在 formulation 阶段就预判并论证这一点（而非等到实验结果证明 joint > sequential），paper 的理论贡献会强很多。
- 价值: 命中 Novelty 维度（防御 trivial alternative 攻击）。这是审稿人最可能问的第一个问题。如果在 approach section 中就给出清晰的理论论证，而不是只靠实验数据说话，paper 的说服力会显著提升。
- 调研依据: 这个论证结构直接参考了经典 psychometrics 中 simultaneous vs. sequential estimation 的讨论传统，以及 Fiedler (arXiv:2605.06939) 关于 shared calibration 导致 sign-reversal 的具体案例——后者正是 sequential estimation bias 的一个实例。

【发掘点 5】
- 维度: related work 差异化
- 内容: 有一篇调研到的论文需要在 related work 中显式定位：**"Quantifying Data Contamination in Psychometric Evaluations of LLMs" (arXiv:2510.07175)**。虽然它关注的是心理学量表（Big Five, PVQ-40）上的 LLM contamination，与本 proposal 的 LLM-as-a-judge benchmark evaluation 是不同场景，但题目中同时出现 "psychometric" 和 "data contamination" 容易让审稿人误以为有重叠。Proposal 应主动做差异化：(1) 该论文研究的是 LLM 作为被试在心理学量表上的 contamination，本文研究的是 LLM 作为评判者在能力 benchmark 上的 contamination；(2) 该论文只做 detection（三个指标的测量），本文做 correction（通过 latent trait model 去除 contamination effect）；(3) 该论文不涉及 judge/rater facet。此外，**"Correcting Human Labels for Rater Effects in AI Evaluation: An Item Response Theory Approach" (arXiv:2602.22585)** 也需要关注——它用 IRT 校正 human rater effects 用于 AI evaluation，是 IRT+rater effects 方向的近期工作，虽然没有涉及 contamination，但审稿人可能认为这是更直接的 prior art。
- 价值: 命中 Related Work 差异化维度。主动定位这两篇潜在"竞品"论文，防止审稿人质疑"this is already done by X"。
- 调研依据: 直接来自 WebSearch 发现的 arXiv:2510.07175 和 arXiv:2602.22585。

Sources:

- [Using Deterministic, Gated IRT Model to Detect Test Cheating](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11336-012-9311-3)

【补救 agent 本轮输出】:
Now I have sufficient research to make a thorough assessment. Let me compile my findings.

---

【状态】: 有缺陷待补救

【前置调研发现】
- **CyclicJudge (arXiv:2603.01865, March 2026)**: 在 MT-Bench 和 MindEval 上做方差分解实验（scenario/generation/judge/residual），baseline 是 single-judge、random-assignment、fixed-judge 等分配策略。评估指标为方差占比和 ranking stability。没有用 contamination 相关的对照。
- **"Judging the Judges" (arXiv:2604.23178, April 2026)**: 比较 9 种 debiasing 策略×5 个 judge 模型×3 个 benchmark (MT-Bench n=400, LLMBar n=200, custom n=225)×4 种 bias type。发现 style bias (0.76–0.92) 远超 position bias (≤0.04)。实验标准：多 benchmark、多 judge 交叉验证。
- **UDA (AAAI 2026)**: 在 pairwise evaluation 中用 neural K-factor 调整 Elo rating，以减少 inter-judge 标准差 63.4%。Baseline 包括 raw Elo、fixed-K Elo、multi-judge average。评估用 Elo convergence dispersion 和 ranking stability。
- **Bias-Bounded Evaluation (arXiv:2603.05485, March 2026)**: 在 Arena-Hard-Auto 上用 4 个 LLM judges 验证，retaining 61–99% ranking correlation (τ)。提供 formal (τ, δ)-bias-bounded guarantees。这是 judge bias 领域唯一提供形式化保证的方法。
- **ConStat (NeurIPS 2024)**: 通过 GPT-4-Turbo 生成 rephrased/synthetic reference samples (~1000/benchmark)，在 MMLU、HellaSwag、ARC 等**多选/factual benchmarks** 上验证。r²=0.94 是在有 ground-truth contamination 的 fine-tuned 模型上验证的。
- **DCR (EMNLP 2025)**: 在 9 个 LLMs (0.5B–72B) 上验证，覆盖 sentiment analysis、fake news detection、arithmetic reasoning。评估 DCR Factor 调整后准确率与 uncontaminated baseline 差距 (~4%)。
- **Preference Leakage (ICLR 2026)**: 定义 3 种 generator-judge 关联（same model, inheritance, same family），用 preference leakage score 量化 bias。实验覆盖多个 LLM baseline 和 benchmark。
- **PSN-IRT (AAAI 2026)**: 在 11 个 benchmarks、41,871 items、12 个 LLMs 上评估。用 neural 4PL IRT 估计 item 参数和 model ability，评估指标包括 measurement quality（reliability, item fit）。
- **Fiedler (arXiv:2605.06939, May 2026)**: 提出 J/ΔJ 诊断指标，在 MMLU-Pro 上展示 sign-reversal failure mode。强调 shared-calibration comparison 的危险性。
- **"How to Correctly Report LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluations" (arXiv:2511.21140)**: 引入 Rogan-Gladen (1978) estimator 用于 bias correction under distribution shift。这是一个理论上 unbiased 的 estimator，可能是审稿人会要求对比的 baseline。
- **MT-Bench 2026 现状**: 多个来源确认 frontier models 在 MT-Bench 上已接近饱和（scores clustering near ceiling），discriminative power 下降。Arena-Hard 和 WildBench 目前仍有区分度。
- **调研总结**: 该领域当前实验标准要求：(1) 多 benchmark 交叉验证（至少 2–3 个）；(2) 多 judge 覆盖（4–8 个，跨 provider family）；(3) 与 Chatbot Arena 的 ranking correlation 作为 primary metric，但通常还需 Spearman-ρ、top-k accuracy 等辅助指标；(4) baseline 需覆盖当前主流的 bias correction 和 contamination detection 方法；(5) 审稿人普遍要求解释 compute overhead 与 improvement 的 trade-off。

---

【缺陷 1】
- 类别: 实验设计不足 — ConStat 从 factual benchmark 到 open-ended generation benchmark 的迁移未充分论证
- 问题: ConStat 原始论文在 MMLU、HellaSwag、ARC 等**有标准答案的 factual/classification benchmark** 上验证（r²=0.94），其 contamination 定义为"performance inflation that does not generalize to rephrased samples"。但 proposal 要将 ConStat 迁移到 MT-Bench、Arena-Hard、WildBench 这些**open-ended generation benchmark** 上，其中 performance 由 LLM judge 评分决定，没有标准答案。这个迁移带来两个未解决的问题：(a) 对 open-ended prompt 进行 rephrasing 后如何确保"等价难度"——factual question 的 rephrasing 保留了唯一正确答案，但 open-ended prompt 的 rephrasing 可能改变任务本质；(b) judge 评分本身引入额外噪声，model 在 original vs. rephrased version 上的 score 差异可能来自 judge inconsistency 而非 contamination。Proposal 中仅提到"GPT-5.5/Claude-assisted rephrasing (validated by human equivalence checking)"，但未说明 equivalence 的具体判定标准、human annotator 数量、inter-annotator agreement 指标。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案: (1) 明确定义 open-ended prompt rephrasing 的 equivalence 标准——建议参考 WildBench 的 checklist-based evaluation，为 original 和 rephrased prompt 生成 task-specific checklist，验证 checklist overlap 率 ≥ 90% 作为 equivalence 标准；(2) 要求至少 3 名 human annotator 对 rephrased prompt 进行 equivalence 判定，报告 Fleiss' κ ≥ 0.7；(3) 在 ConStat delta score 计算中，使用**同一组 judge**对 original 和 rephrased version 评分，以控制 judge noise；(4) 在论文中增加一个 validation study 小节，展示 ConStat 在 open-ended benchmark 上的 calibration quality（e.g., 用已知 contaminated 模型验证 delta score 是否能正确反映 contamination）；(5) 如果资源允许，可以在一个有 ground truth 的小规模 controlled experiment 中验证（e.g., 对 open-weight model 在特定 MT-Bench 子集上做 fine-tuning，人为注入 contamination，验证 ConStat delta score 与注入量的相关性）。
- 调研依据: ConStat 原论文 (NeurIPS 2024) 的实验仅在 factual benchmarks 上验证；open-ended generation benchmark 的 rephrasing 等价性问题在调研中未发现成熟解决方案，属于本 proposal 需要自行解决的 methodological gap。

【缺陷 2】
- 类别: baseline 不足或过时
- 问题: Proposal 列出的 5 个 baseline（raw multi-judge averages, CyclicJudge, DCR, Preference Leakage, naive two-stage pipeline）覆盖了 bias-only 和 contamination-only 两类，但遗漏了两个审稿人很可能要求对比的方法：(a) **UDA (AAAI 2026)** — 同样解决 judge bias，通过 neural K-factor 动态调整 Elo rating，inter-judge 标准差降低 63.4%。UDA 在 Landscape 中已被提及但未列为 baseline。(b) **Bias-Bounded Evaluation (arXiv:2603.05485)** — 该领域唯一提供 formal (τ, δ)-bias-bounded guarantees 的方法，在 Arena-Hard-Auto 上 retaining 61–99% ranking correlation。这两个都是 2026 年的 judge bias correction 新方法，审稿人会期望看到与它们的对比。此外，"How to Correctly Report LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluations" (arXiv:2511.21140) 中的 Rogan-Gladen estimator 是一个理论上 unbiased under distribution shift 的简单 baseline，也应考虑纳入。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案: (1) 将 UDA 加入 baseline list 作为第 6 个 baseline — UDA 基于 Elo rating 的 pairwise evaluation，与 G-MFRM 的 scoring-based evaluation 不完全可比，但可以在同一组 pairwise data 上运行 UDA 然后转换为 ranking，再比较 Kendall-τ；(2) 将 Bias-Bounded Evaluation 加入作为第 7 个 baseline — 它提供了形式化保证，审稿人会想看 G-MFRM 的 empirical improvement 是否超过 Bias-Bounded 的 guaranteed performance；(3) Rogan-Gladen estimator 可以作为 supplementary baseline，因为它是一个极其简单的 bias correction 方法，能帮助展示 G-MFRM 的 added value。增加这些 baseline 的 compute cost 较低（UDA 和 Bias-Bounded 都有公开代码），主要是集成工作。
- 调研依据: UDA (AAAI 2026) 在 judge bias correction 领域报告了 SOTA 的 inter-judge agreement improvement；Bias-Bounded Evaluation 是唯一提供 formal guarantee 的方法；两者都是 2026 年发表/预印的，审稿人对这些 concurrent work 会有较高期望。

【缺陷 3】
- 类别: 评估方案缺陷
- 问题: Proposal 的 primary evaluation metric 是 Kendall-τ rank correlation with held-out Chatbot Arena human votes。虽然这是该领域的标准做法（Arena-Hard、WildBench 都以此验证），但仅用单一 correlation metric 有以下风险：(a) Kendall-τ 对 top-ranked models 的 ranking 变化不够敏感——如果 G-MFRM 主要改善了 mid-tier 模型的排名但 top-3 保持不变，Kendall-τ 可能差异很小；(b) Chatbot Arena 的 prompt distribution 与 MT-Bench/Arena-Hard/WildBench 有显著差异（Arena 是 crowdsourced open-ended conversations），ranking correlation 可能因为 prompt distribution mismatch 而被 attenuate；(c) 没有 per-model 的 evaluation — 无法展示 G-MFRM 具体修正了哪些模型的错误排名。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案: (1) 增加 **Spearman-ρ** 和 **weighted Kendall-τ (τ_w)** 作为辅助 correlation metrics — τ_w 对 top-rank discordance 给予更高权重，更适合评估 evaluation framework 的实用价值；(2) 增加 **top-k ranking accuracy**（k=3, 5）——检验 G-MFRM 是否正确识别了 top 模型；(3) 增加 **pairwise accuracy** — 对每对模型，检验 G-MFRM 是否与 Chatbot Arena 的 pairwise 结果一致；(4) 增加 **per-model case study** — 展示 2–3 个 G-MFRM correction 最显著的模型，可视化其在 raw average vs. G-MFRM 中的排名变化，并分析 contamination estimate c_n 与已知信息的一致性；(5) 如果可能，在 Chatbot Arena 的 category-specific leaderboard（e.g., coding, math, hard prompts）上分别计算 correlation，检验 G-MFRM 在不同 prompt type 上的表现。
- 调研依据: WildBench 论文同时报告了 Pearson correlation 和 Spearman ρ；Arena-Hard 报告了 confidence interval bootstrap；"Judging the Judges" (Soumik 2026) 使用了多种 bias metric 交叉验证。领域标准是多指标验证。

【缺陷 4】
- 类别: 实验设计不足 — MT-Bench 饱和问题
- 问题: 多个 2026 年来源确认 frontier models 在 MT-Bench 上已接近 ceiling（scores clustering at 9.0+）。Proposal 使用的 8 个 judge 中多数为 2026 frontier models（GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Sonnet 4.6, DeepSeek-V4-Pro 等），它们**既作为 judge 又可能作为被评估模型**。如果被评估模型在 MT-Bench 上的 scores 高度聚集，MFRM 的 item difficulty 和 model ability 估计将缺乏足够方差，导致 contamination effect (c_n · e_i) 难以从 noise 中分离。这不影响 Arena-Hard 和 WildBench（目前仍有区分度），但可能导致 MT-Bench 上的结果缺乏说服力。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案: (1) 在论文中明确报告 MT-Bench 上各模型的 score distribution 和 variance，如果 variance 极低则坦诚说明 limitation；(2) 将 MT-Bench 的 primary 地位降为 supplementary，以 Arena-Hard 和 WildBench 作为 primary benchmark — 它们在 2026 仍有区分度；(3) 考虑增加一个更有区分度的 benchmark，例如 **Arena-Hard v2**（如果存在更新版本）或 **LMSYS-Chat-1M 子集**；(4) 在 evaluating models 时纳入 2–3 个非 frontier 模型（如 Llama 4 8B、Qwen3-7B）增加 score range，使 MFRM 有更多 variance 来估计参数；(5) 如果 MT-Bench 饱和严重，可以在 ablation 中展示 G-MFRM 在高区分度 benchmark (Arena-Hard) vs. 低区分度 benchmark (MT-Bench) 上的 correction 效果差异，这本身也是一个有价值的 finding。
- 调研依据: 多个 2026 年 benchmark 综述确认 MT-Bench 对 frontier models 的 discriminative power 下降；PSN-IRT (AAAI 2026) 的经验是在 41,871 items 上才获得可靠的 IRT parameter estimates。

【缺陷 5】
- 类别: ablation 不完整
- 问题: Proposal 列出了 5 项 additional analyses（exposure indicator ablation, judge count sensitivity, facet fit statistics, person-fit validation, adversarial robustness），但遗漏了两个重要的 ablation：(a) **Gating mechanism ablation** — G-MFRM 的核心创新是 multiplicative gating (c_n · e_i)，但没有与 additive contamination control（即 logit(P) = θ_n − b_i − d_j + c_n + e_i，additive main effects without interaction）做对比。如果 additive model 表现相当，则 multiplicative gating 的 added complexity 不 justified。(b) **Stage-wise ablation** — 没有对比"Stage 1 + Stage 2 only (不做 Stage 3 joint refit)"vs."full 3-stage pipeline"。Stage 1+2 的 sequential approach 本质上就是 proposal 中批评的"naive two-stage pipeline"的 psychometric 版本，如果 Stage 3 joint refit 的 improvement 不显著，则 joint estimation 的核心 claim 被削弱。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案: (1) 增加 **additive baseline ablation**：logit(P) = θ_n − b_i − d_j + c_n + e_i，其中 c_n 和 e_i 作为 additive main effects（无交互），验证 multiplicative gating 是否显著优于 additive control；(2) 增加 **Stage 3 contribution ablation**：比较 Stage 1+2 sequential estimates vs. Stage 3 joint estimates 的 Kendall-τ 差异，量化 joint refit 的边际贡献；(3) 这两个 ablation 的 compute cost 很低（仅需重新 fit 变体模型），不影响 timeline。
- 调研依据: DG-IRT 原论文 (Shu et al., Psychometrika 2013) 对 gating vs. non-gating model 做了 formal comparison；AMMI 文献中 rank-1 vs. additive main effects 的对比是标准做法。领域实验规范要求隔离每个组件的贡献。

【缺陷 6】
- 类别: 实验设计不足 — Compute overhead 和实用性讨论缺失
- 问题: Proposal 详细描述了 G-MFRM 的技术优越性，但没有讨论其 compute/cost overhead 相对于 baselines 的 trade-off。CyclicJudge 是 cost-neutral（与 single-judge 相同 per-item cost）；raw multi-judge average 只需要 forward pass；Preference Leakage calibration 是 post-hoc 调整。而 G-MFRM 需要：(1) ConStat reference benchmark 构建（2 周 + human validation）；(2) 3-stage MCMC fitting；(3) multi-judge evaluation on both original and reference variants。审稿人会问："Kendall-τ 提升 X 个百分点 justify 了多少额外的 compute 和 human effort？"
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案: (1) 在实验结果中增加一个 **efficiency-improvement tradeoff table**，列出每种方法的 compute cost（API calls, GPU hours, human hours）和对应的 Kendall-τ；(2) 讨论 G-MFRM 的 amortized cost — 一旦 reference benchmark 构建完成，后续新模型的评估只需增量 MCMC fitting（新模型的 θ_n 和 c_n），不需要重建 reference benchmark；(3) 讨论 practical use scenario — G-MFRM 适合用于高 stakes 的 official leaderboard evaluation（如 Chatbot Arena），而非日常 model development，这个 positioning 有助于 justify overhead。
- 调研依据: 基于领域实验规范判断 — Arena-Hard 和 WildBench 论文都讨论了 cost vs. correlation tradeoff；CyclicJudge 明确以 cost-neutral 作为 selling point。

【缺陷 7】
- 类别: 可行性问题 — 被评估模型集合定义模糊
- 问题: Proposal 列出了 8 个 LLM judges（GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Sonnet 4.6, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, Kimi K2.6, Qwen3-235B-A22B, Qwen3.6-27B, Llama 4 Maverick），但没有明确说明**被评估模型集合**（即 MFRM 中的 n = 1, ..., N）是什么。这些 8 个模型既是 judges 又是 examinees？如果是，这会引入严重的 self-evaluation contamination（judge 评估自己的输出）。如果被评估模型集合不同，需要明确列出。此外，N = 8 或更少意味着 model ability θ_n 和 contamination susceptibility c_n 各仅有 8 个参数，对 Bayesian estimation 来说 sample size 可能偏小（虽然 item 数可以很大）。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案: (1) 明确被评估模型集合 — 建议设为 15–20 个模型，覆盖不同 scale（7B, 27B, 70B, MoE, frontier）和不同 provider family，以增加 θ_n 和 c_n 的估计精度；(2) 在 experimental design 中明确处理 judge = examinee 的情况 — 可以采用 leave-one-out: 当 model A 作为 examinee 时，排除 model A 作为 judge 的评分，或者将 self-evaluation 作为 bias 的一个 facet 进行建模；(3) 分析 judge-examinee overlap 对结果的 sensitivity — 作为 robustness check。
- 调研依据: CyclicJudge 采用 round-robin 避免 self-evaluation；"Judging the Judges" (Soumik 2026) 明确排除了 self-evaluation 场景。Preference Leakage (ICLR 2026) 专门研究了 generator-judge 关联性问题，同 family 的 bias 已被证实显著。

content.content:
1	# Gated Many-Facet Rasch Measurement for Joint Judge Bias and Contamination Correction in LLM Evaluation
2	
3	## Description
4	We propose the Gated Many-Facet Rasch Model (G-MFRM), which extends the standard MFRM from educational measurement with a DG-IRT-inspired contamination gating mechanism to jointly calibrate model ability, item difficulty, judge severity, and contamination susceptibility within a single psychometric framework. The critical methodological advance over the original proposal is a hierarchical contamination parameterization: instead of an overparameterized per-(model,item) contamination term c_nk (N×I free parameters, unidentifiable), we decompose contamination into per-model susceptibility c_n modulated by per-item exposure indicators e_i, giving c_n · e_i (N+I parameters). This follows the LLTM (Fischer 1973) design-matrix tradition and the AMMI multiplicative interaction decomposition, both with established identifiability guarantees. Crucially, exposure indicators e_i are estimated externally via ConStat reference benchmark comparison (fully black-box, validated r²=0.94), temporal pre/post-cutoff signals, and LogProber Safe Scores (gray-box) — resolving the circularity of using model-internal residuals to identify contamination. A three-stage estimation strategy ensures identification: (1) standard 3-facet MFRM producing ability, difficulty, and severity estimates plus person-fit diagnostics; (2) external exposure estimation from ConStat and temporal proxies; (3) joint Gated MFRM with fixed exposure indicators and informative priors from Stages 1–2, implemented via Bayesian MCMC in NumPyro. The n-gram overlap signal is dropped for proprietary models (training data undisclosed) and retained only as supplementary validation for open-weight models. Validation spans MT-Bench, Arena-Hard, and WildBench using 8+ LLM judges (GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Sonnet 4.6, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, Kimi K2.6, Qwen3-235B-A22B, Qwen3.6-27B, Llama 4 Maverick). We demonstrate that G-MFRM fair scores achieve higher Kendall-τ rank correlation with held-out Chatbot Arena human votes than raw multi-judge averages, CyclicJudge bias-only correction, DCR contamination-only adjustment, Preference Leakage calibration, and a naive two-stage pipeline (CyclicJudge → DCR). Additional analyses include exposure indicator ablation, judge count sensitivity, facet fit statistics, person-fit validation of contamination estimates, and robustness to adversarial contamination (per ICLR 2026 fragility findings). The unified framework yields interpretable per-model contamination estimates, per-judge severity calibrations, and fair ability rankings — bridging the gap between the judge bias correction and contamination detection research silos.
5	
6	## Core Problem
7	Can a hierarchical psychometric measurement model jointly estimate model ability, item difficulty, judge severity, and contamination susceptibility — with the contamination facet decomposed into identifiable per-model and per-item components anchored by external exposure proxies — to produce bias-and-contamination-corrected evaluation scores that outperform both siloed corrections and naive multi-judge averaging?
8	
9	## Opportunity
10	The LLM-as-a-judge evaluation literature has bifurcated into two silos: (1) judge bias correction methods (CyclicJudge round-robin, Bias-Bounded Evaluation, Soumik's 9-strategy comparison, UDA neural calibration, Fiedler's classical test theory diagnostics) and (2) contamination detection/adjustment methods (DCR Factor, ConStat, Preference Leakage calibration, person-fit screening). No existing work — including all arXiv submissions through May 2026 and ICLR/EMNLP 2026 proceedings — jointly models judge severity and contamination susceptibility within a single calibration framework. The Many-Facet Rasch Model (MFRM) from educational testing naturally accommodates multiple facets in a unified calibration. Recent work has applied MFRM to LLM raters (arXiv:2505.18486) but treats contamination as external. Critically, the Deterministic Gated IRT (DG-IRT) model from psychometric cheating detection (Shu, Henson & Luecht, Psychometrika 2013) provides the missing link: a principled gating mechanism that decomposes observed performance into genuine ability and contamination-inflated components. By combining MFRM's multi-facet structure with DG-IRT's gating logic and externally-anchored exposure indicators from ConStat, we obtain a unified, identifiable model that bridges the gap between these two research silos.
11	
12	## Landscape
13	**Judge bias silo:** CyclicJudge (March 2026) eliminates judge bias via round-robin assignment but ignores contamination. IRT-GRM for judge reliability (Feb 2026) diagnoses judge consistency without modeling contamination. 'Judging the Judges' (Soumik, arXiv:2604.23178, April 2026) empirically compares 9 debiasing strategies across 5 judges, finding style bias dominant (0.76–0.92) but provides no measurement model explaining why strategies work. 'Bias and Uncertainty in LLM-as-a-Judge Estimation' (Fiedler, arXiv:2605.06939, May 2026) introduces formal J/delta-J diagnostics and identifies sign-reversal failure modes in shared-calibration comparisons, but stays within classical test theory without latent trait modeling. BiasScope (ICLR 2026) automates bias discovery post-hoc. Bias-Bounded Evaluation (March 2026) provides formal guarantees retaining 61–99% ranking correlation. JudgeBiasBench (March 2026) defines a taxonomy of 12 bias types across 4 dimensions. UDA (AAAI 2026) uses neural K-factor adjustment to reduce inter-judge standard deviation by 63.4%. **Contamination silo:** DCR Factor (EMNLP 2025) adjusts accuracy for contamination via fuzzy inference but ignores judge effects. Preference Leakage (ICLR 2026) quantifies generator-judge relatedness bias but proposes only post-hoc calibration. ConStat (NeurIPS 2024) computes contamination effects via reference benchmark comparison (r²=0.94 with true effects) — fully black-box. LogProber (2024) estimates per-item Safe Scores from token log-probabilities. 'On The Fragility of Benchmark Contamination Detection in Reasoning Models' (ICLR 2026) shows RL post-training obscures contamination signals, motivating multi-indicator approaches. **IRT for LLMs (no judge + contamination unification):** PSN-IRT (AAAI 2026) applies neural 4PL IRT to benchmark evaluation. MFRM has been applied to compare 10 LLM raters with human experts (May 2025) and to ChatGPT-4 essay scoring (RMAL 2024). **Gap:** No existing work jointly models judge severity and contamination susceptibility within a single psychometric calibration framework, nor has anyone adapted DG-IRT's gating mechanism from educational cheating detection to LLM benchmark contamination.
14	
15	## Approach
16	We propose a Gated Many-Facet Rasch Model (G-MFRM) that extends the standard MFRM with a DG-IRT-inspired contamination gating mechanism, using a three-stage estimation strategy that ensures identifiability.
17	
18	**Model formulation.** The core log-odds model is:
19	
20	  logit(P_nij) = θ_n − b_i − d_j + c_n · e_i
21	
22	where θ_n is model ability, b_i is item difficulty, d_j is judge severity, c_n is per-model contamination susceptibility, and e_i is per-item exposure level. The contamination term c_n · e_i replaces the overparameterized per-(model,item) c_nk from the original proposal: instead of N×I free parameters, this hierarchical decomposition requires only N + I parameters (or just N when e_i is externally anchored). This follows the LLTM (Linear Logistic Test Model, Fischer 1973) tradition of decomposing item parameters via a known or estimable design matrix, and is a rank-1 special case of the AMMI (Additive Main Effects and Multiplicative Interaction) decomposition, both with well-established identifiability guarantees.
23	
24	The DG-IRT gating interpretation: when e_i ≈ 0 (unexposed item), the model reduces to the standard 3-facet MFRM measuring genuine ability; when e_i > 0, performance is inflated by c_n · e_i, where c_n captures how much each model benefits from data leakage. This directly mirrors DG-IRT's decomposition of observed performance into genuine and cheating-inflated distributions.
25	
26	**Three-stage estimation (resolving circularity).**
27	
28	*Stage 1 — Standard 3-facet MFRM:* Fit θ_n, b_i, d_j via Bayesian MCMC (NumPyro on GPU), ignoring contamination. This produces uncontaminated ability estimates and, critically, standardized residuals r_ni and person-fit statistics (lz, EMRi) per model.
29	
30	*Stage 2 — External exposure estimation:* Estimate e_i from external proxies that are independent of the MFRM fit, resolving the circularity the reviewer identified:
31	  (a) ConStat delta scores: compare model performance on original benchmark items vs. rephrased/synthetic reference variants (fully black-box, validated r²=0.94 with true contamination effects);
32	  (b) Temporal signals: performance gaps on items with pre-cutoff vs. post-cutoff variants (available for benchmarks with versioned items);
33	  (c) LogProber Safe Scores: per-item memorization indicators from token log-probability analysis (gray-box; for models exposing logprobs: GPT-5.5, DeepSeek-V4, Qwen3, Llama 4).
34	  These indicators are combined via a weighted composite (weights tuned on a held-out validation split) to produce ê_i. Person-fit statistics from Stage 1 serve as validation — models with high contamination should exhibit difficulty-insensitive response patterns (high Guttman errors, low lz) — but are NOT used to estimate e_i, avoiding circularity.
35	
36	*Stage 3 — Joint Gated MFRM:* Refit the full 4-facet model with ê_i as fixed (observed) covariates and c_n as latent parameters, using Stage 1 estimates as informative priors. Identifiability constraints: sum(c_n) = 0 (centered contamination susceptibility) and ê_i scale fixed from Stage 2. This yields contamination-corrected 'fair scores' θ̂_n — model ability estimates purged of both judge bias (via d_j) and contamination inflation (via c_n · ê_i).
37	
38	**N-gram overlap dropped for proprietary models.** Following the reviewer's feedback, we remove n-gram overlap as a contamination signal since OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google do not disclose training data. ConStat and temporal signals are fully black-box; LogProber requires only logprob access. # Gated Many-Facet Rasch Measurement for Joint Judge Bias and Contamination Correction in LLM Evaluation

## Description
We propose the Gated Many-Facet Rasch Model (G-MFRM), which extends the standard MFRM from educational measurement with a DG-IRT-inspired contamination gating mechanism to jointly calibrate model ability, item difficulty, judge severity, and contamination susceptibility within a single psychometric framework. The critical methodological advance over the original proposal is a hierarchical contamination parameterization: instead of an overparameterized per-(model,item) contamination term c_nk (N×I free parameters, unidentifiable), we decompose contamination into per-model susceptibility c_n modulated by per-item exposure indicators e_i, giving c_n · e_i (N+I parameters). This follows the LLTM (Fischer 1973) design-matrix tradition and the AMMI multiplicative interaction decomposition, both with established identifiability guarantees. Crucially, exposure indicators e_i are estimated externally via ConStat reference benchmark comparison (fully black-box, validated r²=0.94), temporal pre/post-cutoff signals, and LogProber Safe Scores (gray-box) — resolving the circularity of using model-internal residuals to identify contamination. A three-stage estimation strategy ensures identification: (1) standard 3-facet MFRM producing ability, difficulty, and severity estimates plus person-fit diagnostics; (2) external exposure estimation from ConStat and temporal proxies; (3) joint Gated MFRM with fixed exposure indicators and informative priors from Stages 1–2, implemented via Bayesian MCMC in NumPyro. The n-gram overlap signal is dropped for proprietary models (training data undisclosed) and retained only as supplementary validation for open-weight models. Validation spans MT-Bench, Arena-Hard, and WildBench using 8+ LLM judges (GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Sonnet 4.6, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, Kimi K2.6, Qwen3-235B-A22B, Qwen3.6-27B, Llama 4 Maverick). We demonstrate that G-MFRM fair scores achieve higher Kendall-τ rank correlation with held-out Chatbot Arena human votes than raw multi-judge averages, CyclicJudge bias-only correction, DCR contamination-only adjustment, Preference Leakage calibration, and a naive two-stage pipeline (CyclicJudge → DCR). Additional analyses include exposure indicator ablation, judge count sensitivity, facet fit statistics, person-fit validation of contamination estimates, and robustness to adversarial contamination (per ICLR 2026 fragility findings). The unified framework yields interpretable per-model contamination estimates, per-judge severity calibrations, and fair ability rankings — bridging the gap between the judge bias correction and contamination detection research silos.

## Core Problem
Can a hierarchical psychometric measurement model jointly estimate model ability, item difficulty, judge severity, and contamination susceptibility — with the contamination facet decomposed into identifiable per-model and per-item components anchored by external exposure proxies — to produce bias-and-contamination-corrected evaluation scores that outperform both siloed corrections and naive multi-judge averaging?

## Opportunity
The LLM-as-a-judge evaluation literature has bifurcated into two silos: (1) judge bias correction methods (CyclicJudge round-robin, Bias-Bounded Evaluation, Soumik's 9-strategy comparison, UDA neural calibration, Fiedler's classical test theory diagnostics) and (2) contamination detection/adjustment methods (DCR Factor, ConStat, Preference Leakage calibration, person-fit screening). No existing work — including all arXiv submissions through May 2026 and ICLR/EMNLP 2026 proceedings — jointly models judge severity and contamination susceptibility within a single calibration framework. The Many-Facet Rasch Model (MFRM) from educational testing naturally accommodates multiple facets in a unified calibration. Recent work has applied MFRM to LLM raters (arXiv:2505.18486) but treats contamination as external. Critically, the Deterministic Gated IRT (DG-IRT) model from psychometric cheating detection (Shu, Henson & Luecht, Psychometrika 2013) provides the missing link: a principled gating mechanism that decomposes observed performance into genuine ability and contamination-inflated components. By combining MFRM's multi-facet structure with DG-IRT's gating logic and externally-anchored exposure indicators from ConStat, we obtain a unified, identifiable model that bridges the gap between these two research silos.

## Landscape
**Judge bias silo:** CyclicJudge (March 2026) eliminates judge bias via round-robin assignment but ignores contamination. IRT-GRM for judge reliability (Feb 2026) diagnoses judge consistency without modeling contamination. 'Judging the Judges' (Soumik, arXiv:2604.23178, April 2026) empirically compares 9 debiasing strategies across 5 judges, finding style bias dominant (0.76–0.92) but provides no measurement model explaining why strategies work. 'Bias and Uncertainty in LLM-as-a-Judge Estimation' (Fiedler, arXiv:2605.06939, May 2026) introduces formal J/delta-J diagnostics and identifies sign-reversal failure modes in shared-calibration comparisons, but stays within classical test theory without latent trait modeling. BiasScope (ICLR 2026) automates bias discovery post-hoc. Bias-Bounded Evaluation (March 2026) provides formal guarantees retaining 61–99% ranking correlation. JudgeBiasBench (March 2026) defines a taxonomy of 12 bias types across 4 dimensions. UDA (AAAI 2026) uses neural K-factor adjustment to reduce inter-judge standard deviation by 63.4%. **Contamination silo:** DCR Factor (EMNLP 2025) adjusts accuracy for contamination via fuzzy inference but ignores judge effects. Preference Leakage (ICLR 2026) quantifies generator-judge relatedness bias but proposes only post-hoc calibration. ConStat (NeurIPS 2024) computes contamination effects via reference benchmark comparison (r²=0.94 with true effects) — fully black-box. LogProber (2024) estimates per-item Safe Scores from token log-probabilities. 'On The Fragility of Benchmark Contamination Detection in Reasoning Models' (ICLR 2026) shows RL post-training obscures contamination signals, motivating multi-indicator approaches. **IRT for LLMs (no judge + contamination unification):** PSN-IRT (AAAI 2026) applies neural 4PL IRT to benchmark evaluation. MFRM has been applied to compare 10 LLM raters with human experts (May 2025) and to ChatGPT-4 essay scoring (RMAL 2024). **Gap:** No existing work jointly models judge severity and contamination susceptibility within a single psychometric calibration framework, nor has anyone adapted DG-IRT's gating mechanism from educational cheating detection to LLM benchmark contamination.

## Approach
We propose a Gated Many-Facet Rasch Model (G-MFRM) that extends the standard MFRM with a DG-IRT-inspired contamination gating mechanism, using a three-stage estimation strategy that ensures identifiability.

**Model formulation.** The core log-odds model is:

  logit(P_nij) = θ_n − b_i − d_j + c_n · e_i

where θ_n is model ability, b_i is item difficulty, d_j is judge severity, c_n is per-model contamination susceptibility, and e_i is per-item exposure level. The contamination term c_n · e_i replaces the overparameterized per-(model,item) c_nk from the original proposal: instead of N×I free parameters, this hierarchical decomposition requires only N + I parameters (or just N when e_i is externally anchored). This follows the LLTM (Linear Logistic Test Model, Fischer 1973) tradition of decomposing item parameters via a known or estimable design matrix, and is a rank-1 special case of the AMMI (Additive Main Effects and Multiplicative Interaction) decomposition, both with well-established identifiability guarantees.

The DG-IRT gating interpretation: when e_i ≈ 0 (unexposed item), the model reduces to the standard 3-facet MFRM measuring genuine ability; when e_i > 0, performance is inflated by c_n · e_i, where c_n captures how much each model benefits from data leakage. This directly mirrors DG-IRT's decomposition of observed performance into genuine and cheating-inflated distributions.

**Three-stage estimation (resolving circularity).**

*Stage 1 — Standard 3-facet MFRM:* Fit θ_n, b_i, d_j via Bayesian MCMC (NumPyro on GPU), ignoring contamination. This produces uncontaminated ability estimates and, critically, standardized residuals r_ni and person-fit statistics (lz, EMRi) per model.

*Stage 2 — External exposure estimation:* Estimate e_i from external proxies that are independent of the MFRM fit, resolving the circularity the reviewer identified:
  (a) ConStat delta scores: compare model performance on original benchmark items vs. rephrased/synthetic reference variants (fully black-box, validated r²=0.94 with true contamination effects);
  (b) Temporal signals: performance gaps on items with pre-cutoff vs. post-cutoff variants (available for benchmarks with versioned items);
  (c) LogProber Safe Scores: per-item memorization indicators from token log-probability analysis (gray-box; for models exposing logprobs: GPT-5.5, DeepSeek-V4, Qwen3, Llama 4).
  These indicators are combined via a weighted composite (weights tuned on a held-out validation split) to produce ê_i. Person-fit statistics from Stage 1 serve as validation — models with high contamination should exhibit difficulty-insensitive response patterns (high Guttman errors, low lz) — but are NOT used to estimate e_i, avoiding circularity.

*Stage 3 — Joint Gated MFRM:* Refit the full 4-facet model with ê_i as fixed (observed) covariates and c_n as latent parameters, using Stage 1 estimates as informative priors. Identifiability constraints: sum(c_n) = 0 (centered contamination susceptibility) and ê_i scale fixed from Stage 2. This yields contamination-corrected 'fair scores' θ̂_n — model ability estimates purged of both judge bias (via d_j) and contamination inflation (via c_n · ê_i).

**N-gram overlap dropped for proprietary models.** Following the reviewer's feedback, we remove n-gram overlap as a contamination signal since OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google do not disclose training data. ConStat and temporal signals are fully black-box; LogProber requires only logprob access. For open-weight models with documented training data (DeepSeek-V4, Kimi K2.6, Qwen3, Llama 4), n-gram overlap can serve as supplementary validation of ê_i estimates.

**Validation.** Experiments span MT-Bench, Arena-Hard, and WildBench using 8+ LLM judges: proprietary (GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Sonnet 4.6) and open-weight (DeepSeek-V4-Pro, Kimi K2.6, Qwen3-235B-A22B, Qwen3.6-27B, Llama 4 Maverick). We construct reference benchmark variants for ConStat by GPT-5.5/Claude-assisted rephrasing (validated by human equivalence checking). We evaluate by demonstrating that G-MFRM fair scores θ̂_n achieve higher Kendall-τ rank correlation with held-out Chatbot Arena human votes than five baselines: (1) raw multi-judge averages, (2) CyclicJudge bias-only correction, (3) DCR Factor contamination-only adjustment, (4) Preference Leakage post-hoc calibration, and (5) a naive two-stage pipeline (CyclicJudge bias correction → DCR contamination adjustment) — the 'simpler baseline' that reviewers would demand to justify the psychometric overhead. Additional analyses include: (a) ablation of each exposure indicator's contribution to ê_i; (b) sensitivity analysis varying the number of judges (2, 4, 6, 8+); (c) facet fit statistics (infit/outfit MNSQ) to validate measurement quality; (d) comparison of Stage 1 person-fit flagging (lz, EMRi) against Stage 3 contamination estimates c_n as a validation of construct coherence; (e) robustness check against adversarial contamination following Wang et al. (ICLR 2026) fragility findings.

## Paper Summary

The paper integrates psychometric rater models into the AI pipeline to improve the reliability and validity of conclusions drawn from human judgments, and demonstrates how item response theory rater models, particularly the multi-faceted Rasch model, can separate true output quality from rater behavior.

The paper addresses the fact that human evaluations play a central role in training and assessing AI models, yet these data are rarely treated as measurements subject to systematic error. It reviews common rater effects, severity and centrality, that distort observed ratings.

I found relevant results for your search. Here's what the research shows:

## arXiv:2511.21140 - "How to Correctly Report LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluations"

The paper addresses how Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely used as scalable evaluators of model responses, but imperfect sensitivity and specificity of the LLM judges induce bias in naive evaluation scores.

### The Rogan-Gladen Estimator in This Context

The bias-adjusted estimator corrects bias due to judge misclassification by incorporating sensitivity and specificity (e.g., Rogan–Gladen style). When sensitivity and specificity are known, a classical result (Rogan & Gladen, 1978) provides an exact adjustment. When they are unknown, they can be estimated from a calibration dataset with human-evaluated labels.

### The Paper's Approach

The paper proposes a simple plug-in framework that corrects this bias and enables statistically principled uncertainty quantification. The framework constructs confidence intervals that account for uncertainty from both the test dataset and a human-labeled calibration dataset. The framework remains unbiased under distribution shift between the test and calibration datasets, in contrast to existing approaches.

The search has returned comprehensive results about ConStat. Here's what I found:

## ConStat: Performance-Based Contamination Detection

ConStat proposes a novel definition of contamination as artificially inflated and non-generalizing benchmark performance and develops a statistical method that reliably detects and quantifies contamination by comparing performance between a primary and reference benchmark relative to a set of reference models.

## Contamination Types and Detection Methods

Syntax-Specific Contamination occurs when the model fails to generalize to semantically equivalent samples—the model has memorized the exact samples in the benchmark, and its performance drops as soon as the wording changes. To measure syntax-specific contamination, rephrased samples in the original benchmark are used to obtain a semantically equivalent benchmark.

Sample-Specific Contamination occurs when the model fails to generalize to new samples from the benchmark distribution. As this is often infeasible in practice, synthetic samples are generated for reference benchmarks by querying a strong LLM using few-shot prompting and varying the provided few-shot examples to increase diversity.

## Effectiveness and Robustness

Models trained on rephrased data, which are designed to evade syntax-specific detection, are still effectively identified by ConStat through its sample-specific contamination analysis. ConStat detects 89.1% of syntax-specifically contaminated models and identifies 98.4% of sample-specifically contaminated models.

Now I have all the information needed. Let me compile my assessment with the cross-validation results and produce the updated proposal.

【阶段】: 迭代第 1 轮

【交叉验证调研】:
1. **Bias-Bounded Evaluation (arXiv:2603.05485)** — 已验证存在。Stanford/Oumi.AI, March 2026, 提供 formal (τ=0.5, δ=0.01)-bias-bounded guarantees, Arena-Hard-Auto 上 61-99% correlation retained, 有开源代码。补救 agent 建议将其加入 baseline 是合理的。
2. **arXiv:2602.22585 (Correcting Human Labels for Rater Effects)** — 已验证存在。Casabianca & Beiting-Parrish, Feb 2026, 用 MFRM 校正 human rater severity，在 OpenAI summarization dataset 上验证。是 IRT+rater effects 的直接 prior art，但仅处理 human raters、不涉及 contamination。发掘 agent 建议在 related work 中定位差异化是正确的。
3. **MT-Bench 饱和** — 已验证。多个 2026 来源确认 frontier models 在 MT-Bench 上接近 ceiling，benchmark 不再区分当代模型。补救 agent 的担忧有实据支撑。
4. **ConStat 对 open-ended benchmarks 的适用性** — 部分验证。ConStat 原论文通过 rephrasing（syntax-specific）和 synthetic generation（sample-specific）创建 reference benchmark，但验证仅在 factual/classification 任务上进行。开放式生成任务的 rephrasing 等价性确实是一个未解决的 methodological gap。
5. **Rogan-Gladen estimator (arXiv:2511.21140)** — 已验证存在。经典 bias correction under distribution shift，但它处理的是 classification-based evaluation（sensitivity/specificity correction），与 G-MFRM 的 scoring framework 不完全可比。作为 supplementary baseline 可以，但不是 primary competitor。

【发掘 agent 有效建议采纳】:
1. **发掘点 1（核心 claim 强化：confounding 论证）** — 已验证/采纳。Fiedler (arXiv:2605.06939) 的 sign-reversal failure mode 确实是 sequential estimation bias 的症状。将核心叙事从 "bridging silos" 升级为 "joint calibration is methodologically necessary due to severity-contamination confounding"，这是本轮最重要的 idea 层面改进。
2. **发掘点 2（DG-IRT 迁移 non-triviality）** — 已验证/采纳。DG-IRT 原论文 (Psychometrika 2013) 确实是 binary exposure + single-rater + known exposure status 设定，与 LLM 场景的 structural differences 客观存在。显式论述 analogy+difference+adaptation 能有效防御 "trivial combination" 攻击。
3. **发掘点 3（significance：interpretability as first-class contribution）** — 部分采纳。interpretability angle (c_n, d_j, e_i 各有实际用途) 有实际价值，采纳。"methodological template for future psychometric LLM evaluation" 这个说法过于宏大，在一篇论文中不宜过度承诺，仅简短提及。
4. **发掘点 4（trivial alternative 防御）** — 已验证/采纳。与发掘点 1 的 confounding 论证合并，在 approach section 中预判并回应 "why not pipeline" 攻击。
5. **发掘点 5（related work 增补 arXiv:2510.07175 + arXiv:2602.22585）** — 已验证/采纳。两篇论文均确认存在且相关。arXiv:2602.22585 是最直接的 IRT+rater 方向 prior art，必须讨论差异化。

【补救 agent 有效建议采纳】:
1. **缺陷 1（ConStat 迁移到 open-ended benchmark）** — 已验证/采纳。增加 equivalence validation protocol：checklist-based equivalence、3+ annotator Fleiss' κ ≥ 0.7、controlled contamination injection validation。
2. **缺陷 2（增加 UDA + Bias-Bounded baselines）** — 已验证/采纳。UDA 和 Bias-Bounded Evaluation 均确认为 2026 重要方法。Rogan-Gladen estimator 因 scope 差异降为 supplementary baseline。
3. **缺陷 3（评估指标扩展）** — 已验证/采纳。增加 Spearman-ρ、weighted τ_w、top-k accuracy、pairwise accuracy、per-model case study。
4. **缺陷 4（MT-Bench 饱和）** — 已验证/采纳。将 MT-Bench 降为 supplementary，Arena-Hard + WildBench 为 primary benchmarks。增加非 frontier 模型扩大 score range。
5. **缺陷 5（ablation 补充）** — 已验证/采纳。增加 multiplicative vs. additive gating ablation 和 Stage 3 joint refit 边际贡献 ablation。DG-IRT 原论文做了 gating vs. non-gating comparison，这是标准做法。
6. **缺陷 6（compute overhead 讨论）** — 已验证/采纳。增加 efficiency-improvement tradeoff table 和 amortized cost 讨论。
7. **缺陷 7（被评估模型集合 + self-evaluation）** — 已验证/采纳。明确 examinee set 为 15-20 模型，采用 leave-one-out 处理 judge=examinee overlap。

【本轮 proposal 主要变更】:
**Idea 层面变更：**
- 核心叙事从 "bridging two silos" 升级为 "joint calibration is methodologically necessary"，增加 confounding 论证
- 增加 DG-IRT 迁移的 non-triviality 论述（analogy + 3 structural differences + design responses）
- 增加 interpretability as first-class contribution 的 significance 论证
- 增加对 trivial two-stage pipeline alternative 的理论预判和防御
- Related work 增加 arXiv:2510.07175 和 arXiv:2602.22585 的差异化定位

**实验层面变更：**
- 增加 UDA、Bias-Bounded Evaluation 为 baselines（共 7 个 + naive pipeline）
- 增加 Spearman-ρ、weighted τ_w、top-k accuracy、pairwise accuracy、per-model case study
- MT-Bench 降为 supplementary，Arena-Hard + WildBench 为 primary

- 增加 ConStat open-ended equivalence validation protocol
- 增加 gating mechanism ablation 和 Stage 3 contribution ablation
- 增加 compute overhead / efficiency tradeoff 讨论

- Baseline 覆盖将较全面（7 个方法 + naive pipeline）
- Ablation 设计合理但需要实际实验验证 joint > sequential 的幅度

# Gated Many-Facet Rasch Measurement for Joint Judge Bias and Contamination Correction in LLM Evaluation

## Description
We propose the Gated Many-Facet Rasch Model (G-MFRM), which extends the standard MFRM from educational measurement with a DG-IRT-inspired contamination gating mechanism to jointly calibrate model ability, item difficulty, judge severity, and contamination susceptibility within a single psychometric framework. The central methodological insight is that judge severity and contamination susceptibility are confounded in existing sequential approaches: bias-only methods (e.g., CyclicJudge) absorb contamination-induced performance inflation into ability estimates, while contamination-only methods (e.g., DCR) misattribute severity-induced score depression to lower contamination. Only joint estimation within a single likelihood avoids this mutual bias propagation — making G-MFRM not merely a convenient integration but a methodologically necessary correction. The contamination facet uses a hierarchical parameterization: per-model susceptibility c_n modulated by per-item exposure level e_i, giving a multiplicative gating term c_n · e_i (N+I parameters instead of N×I). This follows the LLTM (Fischer 1973) design-matrix tradition and the AMMI multiplicative interaction decomposition, both with established identifiability guarantees. The DG-IRT (Shu, Henson & Luecht, Psychometrika 2013) cross-domain transfer is non-trivial: while the structural analogy (examinee→LLM, item exposure→benchmark leakage, cheating ability→contamination susceptibility) is straightforward, three key differences required new design decisions: (1) DG-IRT uses binary exposure indicators, but LLM benchmark contamination is continuous → motivating continuous e_i; (2) DG-IRT operates in single-rater (machine-scored) settings with no judge facet → motivating the MFRM d_j integration; (3) DG-IRT assumes administrator-known exposure status → motivating the entire Stage 2 external anchoring pipeline. Exposure indicators e_i are estimated externally via ConStat reference benchmark comparison (fully black-box, validated r²=0.94), temporal pre/post-cutoff signals, and LogProber Safe Scores (gray-box) — resolving the circularity of using model-internal residuals to identify contamination. A three-stage estimation strategy ensures identification: (1) standard 3-facet MFRM producing ability, difficulty, and severity estimates plus person-fit diagnostics; (2) external exposure estimation from ConStat and temporal proxies; (3) joint Gated MFRM with fixed exposure indicators and informative priors from Stages 1–2, implemented via Bayesian MCMC in NumPyro. Beyond ranking accuracy, G-MFRM yields interpretable multi-dimensional output: per-model contamination susceptibility c_n (for training pipeline auditing), per-judge severity d_j (for judge selection/calibration), per-item exposure level e_i (for benchmark maintenance and item retirement), and per-item difficulty b_i — a "single fit, multi-dimensional insight" advantage over methods that only output corrected rankings.

## Core Problem
Can a hierarchical psychometric measurement model jointly estimate model ability, item difficulty, judge severity, and contamination susceptibility — with the contamination facet decomposed into identifiable per-model and per-item components anchored by external exposure proxies — to produce bias-and-contamination-corrected evaluation scores that outperform both siloed corrections and naive sequential pipelines? And critically: is joint estimation methodologically necessary (not merely convenient) because judge severity and contamination susceptibility are confounded in sequential approaches?

## Opportunity
The LLM-as-a-judge evaluation literature has bifurcated into two silos that use different formalisms, tools, and even research communities: (1) judge bias correction methods (CyclicJudge round-robin, Bias-Bounded Evaluation formal guarantees, Soumik's 9-strategy comparison, UDA neural calibration, Fiedler's classical test theory diagnostics) and (2) contamination detection/adjustment methods (DCR Factor, ConStat, Preference Leakage calibration, person-fit screening). No existing work — including all arXiv submissions through May 2026 and ICLR/EMNLP 2026 proceedings — jointly models judge severity and contamination susceptibility within a single calibration framework. This is not merely an integration gap but a methodological problem: sequential correction (first debias, then decontaminate, or vice versa) introduces estimation bias because the first step's errors propagate as input bias to the second step without uncertainty propagation, and because each step cannot distinguish its target effect from the other's confounding influence. Fiedler (arXiv:2605.06939) has already documented a specific instance of this problem — sign-reversal failure modes in shared-calibration comparisons — which we characterize as a symptom of sequential estimation bias that G-MFRM's joint likelihood resolves. The Many-Facet Rasch Model (MFRM) from educational testing naturally accommodates multiple facets in a unified calibration. Recent work has applied MFRM to LLM raters (arXiv:2505.18486) but only for diagnosing rater effects, not modeling contamination. Casabianca & Beiting-Parrish (arXiv:2602.22585) use MFRM to correct human rater effects in AI evaluation, but focus on human (not LLM) raters and do not model contamination. The DG-IRT model from psychometric cheating detection (Shu, Henson & Luecht, Psychometrika 2013) provides the missing link: a principled gating mechanism that decomposes observed performance into genuine ability and contamination-inflated components. Separately, "Quantifying Data Contamination in Psychometric Evaluations of LLMs" (arXiv:2510.07175) studies contamination in psychological scales (Big Five, PVQ-40) where LLMs are test-takers, doing detection only without correction and without judge modeling — a distinct setting from our LLM-as-a-judge benchmark evaluation with latent trait correction.

JudgeBiasBench (March 2026) defines a taxonomy of 12 bias types across 4 dimensions. UDA (AAAI 2026) uses neural K-factor adjustment to reduce inter-judge standard deviation by 63.4% in Elo-based pairwise evaluation.
